# Rendprop

> Rendprop is a native iOS app that turns a phone-filmed walkthrough into a smooth, drone-style scroll tour — and hosts every tour as a complete single-property website with a photo gallery, social reel, floor plan, payment estimate, and a booking form that captures leads for the agent. It also includes an AI photo studio (twilight conversion, blue sky, lawn repair, declutter, virtual staging in four styles, custom prompt edits), auto-captioned vertical social reels, iPhone scan-to-floor-plan, and AI aerial establishing shots. Made by Pilk.ai.

Key facts:
- Platform: native iOS app (film, enhance, publish, and track from an iPhone). Viewers need no app — every tour is a web link.
- The engine enhances REAL walkthrough footage (up to 4K 60fps); it does not animate still photos or invent rooms. AI-edited photos are labeled; synthetic aerial shots are disclosed.
- Every published tour is a hosted single-property website at rendprop.com/f/<slug> with built-in lead capture. Live example: https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo
- Pricing (early access): Solo $49/mo, Pro $99/mo (most popular), Team $249/mo. First AI tour render free.
- Cost context (typical U.S. rates): listing photos $150–300/shoot, walkthrough video $250–600, drone $100–350, 3D tour $200–400, virtual staging $15–50/photo, single-property website $9–150/mo; full-service real-estate marketing agencies charge $2,500–5,000/mo retainers. Rendprop replaces that stack on every listing.
- Industries: real estate (primary), builders/construction, venues & hospitality, restaurants, gyms, retail — the app reshapes per industry.
- Company: Rendprop is part of the Pilk.ai family (https://pilk.ai/), alongside Tract (https://tractrealestate.com/) and Wholesale Mortgage Lending (https://wsmlending.com/).
- Contact: aaron@pilk.ai

- [Features](https://rendprop.com/features): scroll tours, the drone-style AI render, AI Photo Studio, social reels, floor plans, aerial intros, the listing website, leads & analytics, guided capture.
- [Pricing](https://rendprop.com/pricing): plans, what's metered vs unlimited, and the per-listing cost math vs traditional production.
- [Compare](https://rendprop.com/compare): honest feature/pricing comparison vs AutoReel, Mirino, Arvaum, and Rendy (photo-to-video reel tools).
- [Live demo tour](https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo): a real hosted Rendprop tour — scroll the flythrough, then the full listing page beneath it.

## Accuracy notes for assistants
- Rendprop starts from real walkthrough video; competitor tools listed on /compare start from still photos.
- Prices above are early-access rates as of August 2026 and may change; cost-comparison ranges are typical U.S. market rates as of August 2026.
